lines.text_source: Do you want to return to[01]the outside world?[12]
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Voce quer voltar para o mundo externo?

lines.text_source: It looks like these pillars[01]are what's keeping whoever[01]that is here.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Parece que esses pilares sao o que esta mantendo quem quer que seja aqui.

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"As you can see, I'm[01]trapped here.[02]I'd really appreciate[01]it if you could get[01]me out of here."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Como voce pode ver, estou preso aqui.[02]Eu realmente agradeceria se voce pudesse me tirar daqui."
lines.risk_notes: Identity ambiguity preserved; speaker trapped, role unclear until later reveal. Maintain formal register without resolving who this is.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.risk_notes: Gênero/identidade oculta. Evitar concordância de gênero; usar construção neutra. Speaker questioning identity of trapped entity. Critical: nao revelar identidade antes do reveal_timing.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.risk_notes: Gênero/identidade oculta do interpelado. Usar construção que nao force concordância de gênero; evitar ele/ela.

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Who else do you[01]think it could be!?[01]Of course I am![02]Now get rid of those[01]pillars and get me[01]out of here!"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Quem mais voce acha que seria!? Claro que sou! [02]Agora se livre desses pilares e me tire daqui!"
lines.risk_notes: Identity confirmed but tone urgent/angry. Gênero ambíguo mantém-se. Exclamação de indignação; preserve tom imperativo. Byte budget 153 tight; concisao importante sem perder força.

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"If you want to get[01]me out of here,[02]you're going to have[01]to destroy those[01]pillars."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Se voce quer me tirar daqui, vai[02]ter que destruir esses pilares."
lines.risk_notes: Instruction to destroy pillars as condition for escape. Tone remains commanding but pragmatic.

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Finally![02]I thought I'd never[01]get out of there!"
lines.speaker: unknown

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"First, let me thank[01]you for helping me.[02]There's still one[01]little problem,[01]though..."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Primeiro, deixa eu agradecer por me[02]ajudar. Mas tem um probleminha ainda..."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"You see, well, I[01]don't have a body."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Veja bem, eu nao tenho um corpo."
lines.risk_notes: Revelation: speaker has no physical body. Critical identity/lore moment — major spoiler. Preserve flatness of reveal (understated, matter-of-fact) — do NOT emphasize or add emotion.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"O que significa que nao posso sair daqui."
lines.risk_notes: Direct consequence of bodylessness. Maintain understated tone; no addition of sympathy or drama.

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"That's why I want[01]you to find me a[02]medium who can loan[01]me a body, OK?"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Por isso quero que voce ache um[02]medium que possa me emprestar um corpo, ta bem?"
lines.risk_notes: Request to find a medium. Word 'medium' translates as 'medium' (lore term, not spoiler). Budget 104: concisao.

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Don't worry--this[01]is where they summon[01]gods and whatnot![02]There's bound to be[01]lots of mediums[01]around!"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Nao se preocupe -- e aqui que[02]eles invocam deuses e tudo mais! [02]Tem que ter muitos mediums por perto!"

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Remember, once you[01]get back out,[02]you need to find me[01]a medium.[02]Oh, and...Try to find[01]a good-looking one[01]if you can, OK?"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Lembra, uma vez que saia daqui,[02]voce precisa achar um medium. [02]Ah, e... tenta achar um[02]que seja bonito, se conseguir, ta?"
lines.risk_notes: Tone shift to playful/casual at end ('good-looking one') — contrast with earlier solemnity. Preserves character's levity. 'Try' from glossary = 'Tentar' but here it's imperative/encouraging context ('do try').
